interface.longDescription:
LEXI is a language-study app. The learner practices in LEXI.

The connected chat creates the next block with create_block. Tests stay in the app, not in chat.
interface.defaultPrompt: The last block is finished. Create the next one with create_block. Do not write the tests in chat.

name: lexi
description: LEXI is a language-study app. The learner practices in LEXI. The connected chat creates the next block with create_block. Tests stay in the app, not in chat.
instructions: When the learner needs the next block, call create_block. LEXI opens the tests in the app. Do not write tests, questions, or choices in chat.
